--- clean.sv
+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if ((a_tem == 8'b0111_0001) && (match))
 			begin
 				match <= 1'b1;
 			end

claims.violated_requirement: The output match should not depend on its previous value when checking the shift register pattern. This mutation causes match to remain asserted once triggered, even if the shift register no longer matches the pattern.
claims.spec_basis: The output `match` should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register `a_tem` matches the specific 8-bit pattern `8'b0111_0001`.

grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.
